items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: We have a black secretary out there, Marvin Young

ctx.x: You mentioned earlier that the union has been weakened lately; it certainly has, at this level, your smaller towns; not in Los Angeles and New York, big cities where you have studio work they're strong, but in these little towns like here the unions are terrible.
Definitely so, and really, believe it or not Preston, it's a little weak, I think, even in the larger towns. We have a black secretary out there, Marvin Young,--
